02 · Outcome Intelligence

Start with the outcome.

Don’t start with a compound. Start with the biology—then compare the strength of evidence behind the molecules being discussed around it.

RecoveryHealing is not one biological process. Metabolic HealthWeight loss is an outcome. Metabolic health is a system. Muscle & PerformanceA stronger signal is not the same as a stronger athlete. LongevityChanging aging biology is not the same as slowing aging. CognitionFeeling sharper is not proven cognitive enhancement. Gut Health“Healing the gut” is not one outcome. SleepSedation is not the same as restorative sleep.
